about.description: Liquity is a decentralized borrowing protocol allowing users to mint LUSD stablecoin by locking Ether as collateral, with minimal governance and protocol fees. It enables efficient, trust-minimized access to leverage on crypto collateral.
about.registryInfo: Liquity Protocol (Liquity AG, Switzerland). Decentralized borrowing protocol issuing LUSD (V1) and BOLD (V2) stablecoins, both fully ETH/LST-collateralized. Founded 2020 by Robert Lauko & Rick Pardoe. LQTY governance token. Liquity V2 launched 2025 with multi-collateral and adaptive interest-rate model.

fees.revenueNotes: Liquity V2 earns ongoing interest charges on collateralized debt (paid in BOLD), redemption fees, and liquidation premiums. Revenue distributed to LQTY stakers + BOLD-stability-pool depositors.
